prompt_base: Concept art of a single small old car abandoned in nature, as a prop for a cozy low-poly 3D island game for children, cute and friendly, nothing dirty, rusty, broken or scary. Match exactly the art style of the reference screenshots: simple chunky rounded shapes, toy-like proportions, flat toon shading with three tones, soft saturated colors, no outlines, no realistic texture. The car is generic, with no brand, no logo, no license plate text. Nature has taken it gently: moss, grass and small flowers growing on it. Show only the car, full object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, on a plain light grey background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no characters.

variantes.prompt: A tiny round two-door car in pastel mint green with big round headlights, moss on the roof and a little patch of daisies growing on the hood.
A small rounded camper van in two tones, cream on top and coral below, with flowers growing from the open side window and a small bird nest on the roof.
A small rounded pickup truck in soft sky blue, the cargo bed full of grass and colorful flowers like a little garden, moss on the wheels.
A small cute rounded hatchback in cherry red, a green vine climbing over one side, a little round bird sitting on the roof and small mushrooms near the wheels.
